audit.why: Favoured (52.23% WR, 4547 games; MC_REAL_GAMES confirms data exists despite an older packet extract once reading 0). Immobile artillery vs a dive kit — Sylas all seven rows. Text matches.
Level chart is Sylas on all rows in full, content and packet — consistent. Spike narrative (bait Satchel, level-6 all-in, roam on his slow clear) matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The three packet suspectNames are false positives (pluralization/capitalization of real names). Real gaps: cooldowns field had no numbers, and the Short Fuse auto-reset burst tell was missing.
audit.why: Kit: W Satchel Charge 20s rank 1 (his only escape), Q Bouncing Bomb 6s, R Mega Inferno Bomb 120s. Missing-interactions flags the P auto-reset tell. The other flagged interaction ('Satchel bypasses resistances') comes from a percentHealth flag that contradicts Riot's own W description, so it was not written.
audit.corrected: Numbers inserted; auto-reset tell added to dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Abscond (shield-dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable for that entire window once it is spent. - Bouncing Bomb (Q) is spammable at 6s — dodge it, then step up. - Hold your R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb is a 120-second global nuke — stolen at 6 it turns your roams into cross-map executes he cannot match.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: A hoarded Hijack is wasted tempo — even his Mega Inferno Bomb, stolen, is free siege damage you should be casting.

edits.before: That’s Ziggs’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His Short Fuse auto-reset glow opens every combo — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by zoning you off the wave with Bouncing Bomb and sieging towers from a range you can never contest.
